mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, which in turn drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following two consecutive quarters of GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with tight labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs MoM signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 10% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% MoM, the combination signals a contraction in both housing and manufacturing sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY < -10% and INDPRO MoM < -1%.
